description: Parent and district agreed to extend the evaluation timeline per the requirements of WAC 392-172A-03005(c) and the agreement is documented in writing. .
Parent repeatedly failed to produce the student for the evaluation. WAC 392-172A-03005(d)(i).

The student transferred in from another district after the consent was obtained and the evaluation had begun but not yet been completed by the sending school district, including a determination of eligibility. WAC 392-172A-03005(d)(ii).
District scheduling/staffing issues and no agreement to extend.
The agreement to extend the evaluation timeline did not meet requirements per WAC 392-172A-03005(c).
